findings: The candidate preserves the recoverable source contract: spiral output/traversal of an existing matrix, rather than silently replacing it with spiral-matrix generation.

The shrinking-boundary invariant explains why each completed edge leaves exactly the smaller unvisited rectangle, including the re-checks that prevent duplicate output on single-row and single-column layers.
The implementation visits each element exactly once and uses constant algorithmic state beyond the required output list.
The executable fixture covers fixed shape/value boundaries and 5000 deterministic random matrices against an independent visited-direction-walk oracle while asserting the input is unmodified.
No production experience, online-judge identity, hidden constraint or source-specific direction is fabricated.
